description:
CCTV camera codes by monument. The 12 monuments with working CCTV cameras and their Computer Station identifiers (60 codes). `codes`
are the literal in-game console codes; when `randomized` is true the trailing `****` is a per-wipe random
4-digit suffix posted near the camera in-game, not a fixed code. `slug` links to `/monuments/{slug}` (null for
Cargo Ship, which is a moving monument). Fixed reference data.
name: get_cctv_codes
title: CCTV camera codes by monument
